We are a mobile mixed animal veterinarian practice. 

Harney Veterinary Services, LLC is dedicated to providing quality and affordable care. Based in Arab and servicing the North Alabama area, we thoroughly enjoy getting to form a relationship with our clients and their pets.

Making an appointment with us is easy.  Visit https://www.harneyvetservices.com/make-an-appointment or call 256-599-0849.

www.harneyvetservices.com
